                                                                                                            with regular exercise was provided.
 Today, he complained of a five-day history of mild right sided lower abdominal pain which responded to
Panadol. His ultrasound revealed severe hydronephrosis along with a mass attached to the liver, while
the surrounding organs and the left kidney were normal. On examination, both his blood pressure and

abdominal mass for due to which the right kidney was shifted had moved below its normal site. Please
note, he has a positive family history of hypertension and is a smoker and a drinker.
